description.value:
An update to a classic, this advanced blade boasts the most powerful high-frequency device ever designed, able to vibrate at 6,000 times per minute, turning armor into a mere suggestion. Along with its elegant design, this Powersword will look as good on your mantle as it does in your hand. Releasing in the Spring of 2077.

Cost: 10,000eb (Super Luxury)

Class: EQ Very Heavy Melee • Skill: Melee Weapons • Range: Melee

Damage: 4d6 • Capacity: N/A • ROF: 1 • Hands: 2

Alt. Firing Modes: None

Concealable: No

Slots: N/A • Attachments: None • Mods: None

Special Features: With the correct biometric key, the user can sacrifice their Move Action to activate this weapon’s high-frequency vibration feature, which remains active until the weapon is dropped or the user deactivates it without an Action. While this feature is active, the weapon can attack through Thin Cover as if it had an active Tech Rebuild, and ignores a target’s armor entirely if it is below SP 15, and whenever it would ablate armor, ablates 1 additional SP.

Range: Melee

Foundry notes:

  • Listed capacity is N/A; the sheet tracks 0.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
